description: Ontario Dam Inventory is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Ontario | Gouvernement de l'Ontario. The Ontario Dam Inventory (ODI) is an inventory of medium and large dams throughout Ontario. It uses a point-based system (x, y location) to identify each dam location. Coverage: Government of Ontario. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Ontario | Gouvernement de l'Ontario. Its tags are Infrastructure and Transportation, Government information, Infrastructure et transport, Information gouvernementale. It offers 13 resource(s) in DOCX, ESRI REST, HTML, OTHER, PDF. The portal shows 2026-03-25 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence – Ontario. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
